title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
summary: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings.

title: Fed raises rates by 25 basis points in first hike since July 2023
summary: The widely expected move places the U.S. Federal Reserve's benchmark fed funds rate range at 3.75%-4.0%.

title: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million over 2020 crash liquidations
summary: The estate is chasing 6,360 BTC lost in the Covid crash — a leveraged long position that sits awkwardly with the lender's delta-neutral marketing.

title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
summary: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

title: Hamas military wing told donors to avoid sending crypto directly from Binance, DOJ filing shows
summary: Hamas’ military wing advised donors not to use Binance to handle funds but rather to use Trust Wallet, Bybit, OKX, Kast and Redotpay to send funds to an external TRON wallet, according to recent U.S. Department of Justice documents.
